recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14082 unless a future work-group decision changes the broader timing choice family.
issue_request: FHIR-14082 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for STU3 asking to add Age as a choice for ActivityDefinition.timing[x] to simplify immunization-program definitions; the applying comment also added the same choice to PlanDefinition.action.timing[x] and RequestGroup.action.timing[x].
initial_application: The Jira comment records application at SVN 12627, and git-svn commit 576fb4b712586e52a5dc45a6f26e5a6deaad7aff added Age to ActivityDefinition.timing[x], PlanDefinition.action.timing[x], and RequestGroup.action.timing[x] in the old spreadsheet sources.
additional_context: The current build uses StructureDefinition XML sources; source/fhir.ini lists ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, and RequestOrchestration as active resources and maps the legacy RequestGroup name to RequestOrchestration. Later timing work such as FHIR-25471 and FHIR-29799 refined the allowed type set and explanatory comments without removing Age.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml, source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml, and source/requestorchestration/structuredefinition-RequestOrchestration.xml already include Age in the relevant timing[x] choice lists, and the ActivityDefinition/PlanDefinition comments explain Age-based timing.

related_jiras.note: Removed dateTime and Period from definitional timing choices while preserving Age and adding explanatory timing comments.
Requested clarification of timing choice meanings and is already reflected in the current comments.
Renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration, explaining the current name of the consistency target.
